steps.title: Design primers to delete IRES
steps.instruction: Design and order PCR primers to remove the IRES from the double‑cut NH‑donor plasmid using NEBaseChanger. Forward primer: 5′‑ATG GTG AGC AAG GGC GAG‑3′; Reverse primer: 5′‑CAA TTG CCG GTG ATG CGG‑3′.

steps.title: Q5 site‑directed mutagenesis PCR
steps.instruction: Dilute double‑cut NH‑donor plasmid to 20 ng/µL in ddH₂O. Prepare a 25 µL PCR reaction with 12.5 µL 2× Q5 Hot Start Master Mix, 1.25 µL each of forward and reverse primers (10 µM), 1 µL plasmid DNA (20 ng/µL) and water to volume. Run: 98 °C 30 s; 25 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 63 °C 30 s, 72 °C 4 min; final 72 °C 2 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Kinase‑Ligase‑DpnI (KLD) treatment
steps.instruction: Mix 5 µL PCR product with 5 µL 10× KLD buffer, 1 µL KLD enzyme mix and 9 µL water (total 20 µL). Incubate at 20‑22 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Heat‑shock transform DH5‑alpha
steps.instruction: Thaw DH5‑alpha competent cells on ice 30 min. Add 100 µL cells to the 20 µL KLD reaction, mix gently, keep on ice 30 min, heat‑shock 42 °C 45 s, place on ice 2 min, add 500 µL 2× YT broth (20‑22 °C) and incubate 37 °C 1 h shaking 300 rpm. Plate 100 µL on LB‑Carb plates (100 µg/mL carbenicillin) pre‑warmed at 37 °C, incubate 16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Pick colonies and grow overnight
steps.instruction: Pick 5‑10 colonies with a pipette tip into separate 14 mL round‑bottom tubes containing 3 mL LB‑Carb broth (100 µg/mL carbenicillin). Incubate 37 °C shaking 200 rpm overnight (≈16 h).

steps.title: Plasmid miniprep, sequencing, glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Perform ZR Plasmid Miniprep‑Classic on 2 mL overnight culture per clone. Measure DNA concentration and purity. Submit 1.2 µg plasmid in 12 µL ddH₂O for Sanger sequencing with primers EGFP‑C‑for and EGFP‑N‑rev. Prepare glycerol stock by mixing 500 µL overnight culture with 500 µL 50 % (w/v) glycerol (filtered 0.2 µm).

steps.title: Confirm IRES removal by sequencing
steps.instruction: Analyze Sanger sequencing results on Day 6 to verify the IRES sequence is absent.

steps.title: Design CDH1 sgRNA in Benchling
steps.instruction: Create a Benchling account, import human CDH1 sequence, locate exon 16, use CRISPR design tool to select sgRNA 5′‑GAG GCG GCG AGG ACG ACT AG‑3′ upstream of the stop codon (on‑target score 18.7, off‑target 91.5). Record the 20‑nt target sequence.

steps.title: Order sgRNA oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Order desalted oligos (sgCDH1_F and sgCDH1_R) at 100 µM in nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Anneal sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Dilute each oligo 1:20 in ddH₂O (final 5 µM). Mix 5 µL sgCDH1_F + 5 µL sgCDH1_R + 90 µL ddH₂O (100 µL total). Thermocycle: 95 °C 5 min; then decrease 1 °C per 1.45 min down to 71 °C; hold 16 °C indefinitely. Verify on 2 % agarose gel.

steps.title: Digest MLM3636 vector with BsmBI
steps.instruction: Set up 50 µL digestion: 1–2 µg MLM3636 plasmid, 5 µL 10× NEB Buffer r3.1, 1–2 µL BsmBI (10–20 U), water to 50 µL. Incubate 55 °C 2 h, heat‑inactivate 80 °C 20 min, hold 16 °C. Run 1 % agarose gel, excise 2 253 bp band, purify with Wizard® SV Gel and PCR Clean‑Up kit.

steps.title: Ligate annealed oligos into vector
steps.instruction: Dilute annealed oligos 1:200 (e.g., 5 µL oligo mix + 995 µL ddH₂O). Set up 20 µL ligation: 100 ng digested vector, 2 µL diluted oligos, 2 µL 2× Rapid Ligation Buffer, 1 µL T4 DNA Ligase, water to 20 µL. Include a control with water instead of oligos. Incubate 4 °C overnight (≈16 h).

steps.title: Heat‑shock transform ligation
steps.instruction: Transform 100 µL DH5‑alpha cells with 20 µL ligation as described in step 4. Plate 100 µL on pre‑warmed LB‑Carb plates, incubate 16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Colony PCR screening
steps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix per reaction (15 µL): 0.15 µL MyTaq (5 U/µL), 0.3 µL human_U6_F (10 µM), 0.35 µL sgCDH1_R1 (10 µM), 3 µL 5× MyTaq buffer, water to 15 µL. Pick a colony with a tip, dip into PCR tube, then into 3 mL LB‑Carb overnight culture. PCR program: 94 °C 1 min; 32 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 55 °C 15 s, 72 °C 30 s; final 72 °C 5 min; hold 16 °C. Run 1.5 % agarose gel; expected band 274 bp indicates correct insertion.

steps.title: Overnight culture of positive colonies
steps.instruction: Inoculate positive colonies into 3 mL LB‑Carb broth, incubate 37 °C shaking 200 rpm for 16 h.

steps.title: Plasmid prep, sequencing, glycerol stock for sgRNA
steps.instruction: Miniprep plasmid from 2 mL overnight culture using ZR Miniprep kit. Measure DNA, send 1.2 µg in 12 µL ddH₂O for Sanger sequencing with human_U6_F primer. Prepare glycerol stock (500 µL culture + 500 µL 50 % glycerol).

steps.title: Analyze sgRNA sequencing results
steps.instruction: Visualize .ab1 files with 4Peaks; if correct, retain plasmid (named sgCDH1) for transfection.

steps.title: Order required plasmids
steps.instruction: Order the four plasmids listed in the key resources table (including double‑cut EGFP donor, hCas9, sgCDH1, and Sg‑A).

steps.title: Streak bacterial stab cultures
steps.instruction: Streak each received stab on an LB‑Carb plate (100 µg/mL carbenicillin) and incubate 16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Inoculate overnight liquid cultures
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony into 3 mL LB‑Carb broth, incubate 16 h at 37 °C shaking 200 rpm.

steps.title: Plasmid purification and glycerol stocks
steps.instruction: Perform ZR Miniprep‑Classic on the 3 mL overnight culture to obtain plasmid DNA (aim ~500 ng/µL, high purity). Prepare glycerol stock as in step 12 (500 µL culture + 500 µL 50 % glycerol). For larger amounts, inoculate 150 mL LB‑Carb with 100 µL overnight culture, grow 16 h at 37 °C 200 rpm, and purify with NucleoBond® Xtra Midi Plus kit.

steps.title: Seed BG1 cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Culture BG1 cells in RPMI + 10 % FBS + 1 % Pen‑Strep in a T75 flask. At ~80 % confluence, detach with 1× Trypsin‑EDTA (10× diluted 1:10 in PBS), count, and resuspend at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Seed 150 000 cells per well in 1 mL RPMI in a 12‑well plate; gently swirl to distribute.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid mix for transfection
steps.instruction: In 1.5 mL tubes, combine plasmids per Table 8 (amounts in ng for a 12‑well): hCas9 600 ng, hCas9_D10A 600 ng, Sg‑A 200 ng, double‑cut EGFP only 600 ng, sgCDH1 200 ng. Include controls (e.g., pmaxGFP, hCas9_D10A alone). Mix gently.

steps.title: Transfect BG1 cells with ViaFect
steps.instruction: Replace medium with 1 mL fresh RPMI 1‑3 h before transfection. Add 100 µL serum‑free RPMI to each plasmid pool, vortex. Warm ViaFect to 20‑22 °C, add 4 µL to each pool, vortex, spin down. Incubate 20‑22 °C 20 min. Add the 104 µL DNA‑ViaFect mix dropwise to the cells, rock plate gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight.

steps.title: Prepare cells for flow cytometry (48 h)
steps.instruction: At 48 h post‑transfection (or when cells reach ~80 % confluence), aspirate medium, wash with 300 µL 1× PBS, add 300 µL 1× Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C up to 15 min until detached. Add 600 µL RPMI to neutralize, pipet to single‑cell suspension. Transfer 300 µL to a 1.5 mL tube for analysis, keep 600 µL in a new 6‑well plate for expansion. Centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 20‑22 °C, resuspend pellet in 120 µL PBS + 1 % FBS (flow buffer), place in a 96‑well plate and run on flow cytometer (e.g., CytoFLEX).

steps.title: Prepare cells for FACS enrichment
steps.instruction: When EGFP+ cells reach 80 % confluence in a T25/T75 flask: wash with 3 mL PBS, add 3 mL 1× Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C until detached. Add 6 mL RPMI to stop, transfer to 15 mL tube. Keep 0.5 mL for backup in a T25 flask. Centrifuge remaining cells 200 × g 5 min at 20‑22 °C, discard supernatant. (Optional) Resuspend in 200 µL DAPI (1:5000 in flow buffer), incubate 5 min in dark, centrifuge 200 × g 5 min, wash twice with 1 mL flow buffer. Resuspend in 1 mL flow buffer, pass through 70 µm cell strainer into a FACS tube. Prepare collection tube with culture medium.

steps.title: Sort EGFP+ cells and plate
steps.instruction: Perform FACS to collect EGFP+ cells into the prepared collection tube. Centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 20‑22 °C, discard supernatant leaving 300‑500 µL, resuspend and plate into appropriate well (e.g., 48‑ or 24‑well) with fresh RPMI + 10 % FBS. Add enough medium to cover cells.

steps.title: Expand and repeat sorting as needed
steps.instruction: Change medium 1 day after sorting, expand culture to ~3 × 10⁶ cells (≈25 cm²) for re‑analysis. Perform flow cytometry again (step 8) and repeat FACS preparation (step 10) if EGFP+ fraction is <80 %. Perform 2‑3 rounds of enrichment as required. Once sufficient, freeze cells in 90 % FBS + 10 % DMSO at –80 °C (or liquid N₂).

steps.title: Genomic DNA isolation for genotyping
steps.instruction: Harvest ~1 × 10⁶ EGFP+ cells, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min at 20‑22 °C, wash with 1 mL PBS, centrifuge again, discard supernatant. Extract DNA using DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit; elute 25‑50 µL buffer. Measure concentration (Nanodrop; aim >200 ng/µL, A260/280 ≈ 1.8, A260/230 ≈ 2.0). Dilute to 100 ng/µL.

steps.title: Genotyping PCRs
steps.instruction: For each of three primer pairs (CDH1_F1/CDH1_R1, CDH1_F1/EGFP‑N_R, EGFP‑C_F/CDH1_R1) prepare master mix per reaction (10 µL): 0.1 µL MyTaq (5 U/µL), 0.2 µL forward primer (10 µM), 0.2 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 2 µL 5× MyTaq buffer, 100 ng DNA, water to 10 µL. PCR program: 95 °C 5 min; 35 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 58 °C 15 s, 72 °C 2 min; final 72 °C 5 min; hold 16 °C. Run products on 1.2 % agarose gel at 120 V 20‑30 min, image. Expected wild‑type band 954 bp, knock‑in band 1712 bp (or 572 bp/554 bp for internal primers).

steps.title: Prepare protein lysates for Western blot
steps.instruction: Grow cells in a 10 cm dish to 80‑90 % confluence. Wash with 5 mL cold 1× PBS, discard. Add 350 µL 1× RIPA (10× diluted) with protease inhibitor (1:100, i.e., 3.5 µL). Keep on ice 5 min, scrape cells, transfer to 1.5 mL tube, incubate on ice 20 min, centrifuge 4 °C full speed 20 min, collect supernatant. Measure protein (Pierce BCA). Dilute to 2 µg/µL, add 4× loading buffer with 2 M DTT (100 µL DTT per 400 µL buffer). Boil 95 °C 5 min, keep on ice.

steps.title: Cast 10 % SDS‑PAGE gels
steps.instruction: Prepare resolving gel (10 mL): 4 mL ddH₂O, 3 mL 30 % Acrylamide/Bis, 2.5 mL 1.5 M Tris pH 8.8, 0.1 mL 10 % SDS, 0.11 mL 10 % APS, 0.1 µL TEMED, 0.004 mL TEMED. Pour, overlay with isopropanol or water, let polymerize ~45 min. Prepare stacking gel (3 mL): 2.13 mL ddH₂O, 0.5 mL 30 % Acrylamide/Bis, 0.3 mL 1 M Tris pH 6.8, 0.03 mL 10 % SDS, 0.03 mL 10 % APS, 0.03 µL TEMED. Remove overlay, pour stacking gel, insert comb, polymerize 15 min. Gels can be stored at 4 °C up to 1 week in moist wrap.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1× running buffer (10× diluted with water). Assemble gel in electrophoresis chamber, fill with running buffer. Load 5 µL protein ladder and appropriate lysate volumes. Run 90 V until samples enter resolving gel, then 120 V until separation is complete. Prepare 1× transfer buffer (10× Transfer Buffer + 100 mL ddH₂O + 200 mL 100 % methanol). Soak PVDF membrane in methanol 30 s, then in water. Soak sponges and Whatman paper in transfer buffer. Assemble sandwich (sponge‑paper‑gel‑PVDF‑paper‑sponge) in transfer apparatus, fill with buffer, keep on ice. Run 75 V for 1.5 h (replace ice after 45 min).

steps.title: Block and incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare 1× TBST (50 mL 10× TBS + 450 mL ddH₂O + 500 µL Tween‑20). Make 1× TBST with 3 % BSA (1.5 g BSA in 50 mL TBST). Submerge PVDF membrane in 20 mL blocking buffer, incubate 20 °C 30 min with gentle agitation. Prepare primary antibody solution in 50 mL tube: 5 mL TBST‑3 % BSA + antibody at manufacturer’s dilution. Cut membrane to size, place in tube, incubate 4 °C 16 h on roller shaker. Wash 3 × 5 min with 5 mL TBST at 20 °C.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody and develop blot
steps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibody 1:10 000 in 1× TBST (e.g., 1 µL in 10 mL). Add 5‑10 mL to membrane, incubate 20 °C 3 h with gentle agitation. Wash 3 × 5 min with TBST. Prepare chemiluminescent substrate by mixing equal volumes of SuperSignal™ West Dura Luminol/Enhancer and Stable Peroxide. Apply dropwise to membrane, image on gel‑doc (e.g., Vilber Fusion FX).

steps.title: Immunofluorescence sample preparation
steps.instruction: Seed 20 000‑50 000 BG1 cells in 500 µL RPMI per well of an 8‑well glass chamber slide. Culture 2 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until ~80 % confluence. Wash once with 300 µL PBS, add 150 µL 4 % formalin, incubate 20‑22 °C 10 min. Wash 3 × 500 µL PBS. Permeabilize with buffer (volume not specified) 20‑22 °C 5 min, wash 500 µL PBS. Block with 200 µL blocking buffer 20‑22 °C ≥1 h (or overnight 4 °C). Add 250 µL primary antibody solution, incubate 4 °C 16 h. Wash 3 × 500 µL washing buffer. Add 250 µL secondary antibody (1:500 in dilution buffer), incubate 20‑22 °C 3 h in dark. Wash 3 × PBS. Add 150‑200 µL ProLong Gold with DAPI, cover with 24 × 60 mm coverslip, seal edges with nail polish, cure 5 min dark 20‑22 °C, then 1 day at 4 °C in dark. Image with confocal microscope (e.g., Nikon CSU W1, 40× air NA 0.95).
